verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a SaaS sales-tax compliance platform, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents data residency or storage-region selection. The many references to jurisdictions, countries and nexus describe tax obligations, not where customer data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
